revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 7.8% and FY2024 5.2% (filed revenue); fade from ~5% toward 3.5% as growth normalises to GDP-plus industrial levels.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: US federal statutory rate 21%; effective rate not pulled from filings.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 986/37442 = 2.6%; FY2024 2.5%; slight uplift to 2.7%.

wacc.source: Assumption/CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + assumed beta ~1.05 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = ~9.5% cost of equity; pre-tax cost of debt ~5.5% assumed, after-tax ~4.3%; ~80/20 equity/debt weights assumed (net debt 21.7B vs equity value much larger) gives ~8.5%. Beta not looked up; reviewer should verify.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run nominal GDP growth and below the 4.86% risk-free rate.
